newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Boulevard unit to buy four aicraft.
newsitem.headline: Boulevard unit to buy four aicraft.

text.p: Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc said on Thursday its wholly owned subsidiary Askar Ltd had entered into a "preliminary agreement" to buy four used aircraft from U.S.-based Triton Aviation Services Ltd.
President Abelardo Villacorta said in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange the four aircraft would be leased by Askar to local carrier Grand International Airways Inc.

"The final terms and conditions of the purchase and sale agreement are still subject to negotiation for execution prior to May 30," he said. "If the transaction is concluded, Boulevard will guarantee the obligation of Askar under the agreement."
Other officials of Boulevard said they expected Askar to take delivery of the four reconditioned Boeing 737 between June and August this year if it closes the deal this month.
